## get_bookings — setup
1. Select a Header Auth credential on the Webhook (for example X-Calnode-Tool-Key).
2. Select your Calnode Bearer credential on Get bookings from Calnode. Use an admin/owner key for all specialists.
3. Check BASE_URL and timezone in Prepare request. No secrets are included in this export.
4. Publish/activate and call the Production URL shown by n8n.

Example POST body:
`{"phone":"+77011234567","event_slug":"rodionova_60_min","date":"2026-11-02"}`

All filters optional. Empty body lists upcoming, non-cancelled bookings. Dates use Asia/Qyzylorda unless timezone is supplied. status=cancelled lists cancellations. when=all includes past/upcoming, not cancellations unless explicitly selected.

Fetches up to 10 pages of 200 bookings. If complete=false, repeat with the same filters and pagination.next_offset as offset. No procedure answers or private manage URLs are returned. See get-bookings/README.md.
